preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore a verifiable combat-readability slice in which Alpha progression unlocks the 3/5/10 encounter and checkpoint-look checks, the shell remains transparent and fully reachable at 100–200% UI scale, and the intact AK-74M viewmodel shows credible two-hand contact throughout ordinary weapon states without regressing clean boot or preserved lifecycle behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The preserved candidate has three independent integration failures: Alpha checkpoint/progression cannot yet support the uninterrupted 3/5/10 encounter and checkpoint-restored look matrix; the shell retains broad opaque loadout cards while its accessibility scaling can hide Settings content; and the intact AK-74M package is framed or bound so its authored support-hand contact is not visible. Prior attempts concentrated on route replay, scale/transform tuning, and evidence dictionaries. This iteration instead repairs the authoritative checkpoint transaction, container hierarchy, and whole-package adapter seams, while adding deterministic non-release branch receipts for focused verification.

stop_conditions: Do not declare completion if clean boot regresses or any changed callback produces a candidate-script runtime error.

Stop viewmodel work before editing imported gun, hand, skeleton, mesh, animation, or authored child transforms; repair only the product-owned whole-package adapter/profile, or report package-level incompatibility for Tester judgment.
Reject any tester setup that has a physical binding, runs in a release export, fabricates UI-only state, bypasses authoritative mission APIs, or omits requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts.
Do not accept branch-local setup as proof of the ordinary spawn-to-Alpha route, navigation, ordered progression, end-to-end completion, or terminal acceptance.

If full-capsule occupancy, navigation support, reciprocal occlusion, or real hand-contact binding cannot be established, retain the issue as insufficient evidence rather than substituting names, synthetic markers, or telemetry claims.

strategy.rationale: Break the three-round stagnation with root-cause repairs at preserved ownership boundaries: make checkpoint progression atomic and observable, replace fixed/card-based UI composition with container-owned reflow, and calibrate the coupled viewmodel through one adapter/profile. Deterministic branch fixtures reduce repeated long-route evidence loss without weakening the ordinary-input golden path.

code: Run the pinned Godot import, parse, and clean-boot checks on the exact candidate; require zero changed-script errors before and after active callbacks.
Inspect project InputMap source to prove every tester_* action has an empty physical event list, and inspect release guards plus requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipt paths.
Verify checkpoint commit and rollback code deduplicates key, route, snapshot, and event submission, preserves the 18 stable identities, and never increases the saved countdown.

Verify the imported AK-74M source remains intact and that framing, source-axis correction, animation mapping, contact evidence, and transient cleanup remain separated by the product-owned adapter hierarchy.
runtime: Tester runs one ordinary-input title-to-Alpha smoke, then retains a single lineage through Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie to sample the 3/5/10 roster, capture causality, occupancy, avoidance, animation, reciprocal occlusion, and final logs.

After the ordinary smoke, Tester invokes each non-release branch action serially and binds requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts to matched runtime state and logs; these captures do not close route or end-to-end acceptance.

Tester applies distinct horizontal and vertical mouse motions after deployment, pause/resume, Settings return, Alpha checkpoint restore, F6, and Replay without restarting Godot, recording yaw, pitch, capture state, cursor visibility, and mouse mode.

Tester exercises AK-74M and Saiga-12 hip, ADS, sustained fire/recovery, reload, switch, Home/new mission, Replay, checkpoint restore, and F6 while checking clip, mount transform, hand-contact evidence, ammo/shot authority, and late errors.
